arrow — ANNOTATE pointer op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.arrow(img, p0, p1, color='emphasis', width=2, head_len=12.0, head_width=9.0, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None) (to call the implementation directly, import annotate; annotate.arrow(img, p0, p1, color='emphasis', width=2, head_len=12.0, head_width=9.0, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None); from the registry, opsannotate.get("arrow"))

Usage

An arrow from p0 to p1 (the shaft via imagedraw.draw_line, the head filled).

Parameters

p0, p1 : (x, y)

Start point and tip. x=col, y=row.

head_len, head_width : float

Arrowhead length and width [px]. 0 gives a plain line segment. For short arrows whose arrowhead is longer than the shaft,

the arrowhead is shrunk similarly to 8/10 of the shaft length (otherwise

the base of the arrowhead would lie behind the start point and the shaft would be drawn backwards).

style : dict or None

Pass-through arguments to imagedraw.draw_line, which draws the shaft (dashes etc.).

Returns

ndarray

Raises

ValueError

end points non-finite or identical, negative thickness or arrowhead size, both ends outside the image.
